description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 009 is a perforated clay brick with round holes, shown on its own in the product photo, listed in the jali range for builders who want to lay a brick jali or ventilated wall rather than use decorative tiles.

## How it looks
The photo shows a single clay brick with a row of round holes through it. Laid on edge or on its side, the holes become small openings in the wall; laid flat, the brick reads as a plain exposed brick. The natural terracotta colour matches traditional red-brick walls.

## Where it works
- **Clay brick jali wall** for boundaries, rooftop parapets and car porches, laid to show the holes.
- **Perforated brick screen** panels in a solid brick wall for ventilation of stairs, stores and kitchens.
- **Hollow brick with round holes** in exposed-brick feature walls where you want texture and small points of light.

Brick jali is a long-standing way of building in South Asia because it uses ordinary masonry skills and keeps air moving through hot buildings.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Form: single perforated clay brick with round holes (from the product photo)
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet; confirm them, and how many holes each brick has, before you calculate quantities.

How the brick is laid changes the look and the strength, so agree the bond and any reinforcement with your mason or engineer. Don't use it for load-bearing walls without their advice. Clean exposed brick with water and a stiff brush.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) with your wall size for a dated quote. Read the [clay products in construction guide](/blog/clay-products-in-building-construction-bricks-tiles-and-terracotta), the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide), or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of perforated clay brick?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: What is a perforated clay brick used for?
faqs.a: Laid to show its holes, it builds a brick jali screen for ventilation and light. Laid flat, it can form a textured exposed-brick wall. Ask your engineer before using it in a load-bearing wall.

faqs.q: Perforated brick or terracotta jali tile: what is the difference?
faqs.a: A perforated brick is laid like ordinary brickwork and suits rugged boundary and parapet walls. Jali tiles and blocks carry a decorative pattern and suit feature walls and facades.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 009" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
